classification.difficultyReason: Construct the right triangle from the description, transfer the depression angle to the elevation angle and rearrange tangent for the horizontal distance.

content.prompt: A man is watching a ship from the top of a scenic lookout. His eye level is 30 m above sea level. If the angle of depression from the man to the ship is $8^\circ$, how far from the foot of the lookout is the ship? Give your answer to the nearest metre.

answer.worked:
The angle of elevation from the ship to the man's eye level is $8^\circ$, since the horizontal lines are parallel. Let $d$ metres be the horizontal distance from the foot of the lookout to the ship.

$$\begin{align*}\tan 8^\circ&=\frac{30}{d}\\d\tan 8^\circ&=30\\d&=\frac{30}{\tan 8^\circ}\\d&\approx213.461\end{align*}$$

The ship is approximately $213\text{ m}$ from the foot of the lookout, to the nearest metre.
